## Governance rules

- Add or update a row whenever a public feature is added, removed, intentionally omitted, or safety-gated. Edit the YAML source `docs/parity/polydart-polygolem.yaml`, then regenerate this matrix with `dart run tool/generate_parity_docs.dart`.
- Prefer local/mock tests for parity evidence. Do not use this matrix as approval for live trades, custody mutations, deployments, publishing, or secret handling.
- CI runs `dart run tool/generate_parity_docs.dart --check` to ensure Polydart test evidence paths exist and this file matches its YAML source.
- `partial` and `missing` rows should include an explicit note explaining whether the gap is intentional, safety-gated, or still planned, plus the upstream commit that introduced it.
